members.reason: [llm] cluster primary: Plain JSON Schema objects passed as inputSchema in the deprecated server.tool() overload are not handled correctly — both PRs modify the same code path in src/server/mcp.ts to address this. (2 PRs)
members.short_reason: [llm] cluster primary: Plain JSON Schema objects passed as inputSchema in the deprecated server.tool() overload are not handled correctly — both PRs modify the same code path in src/server/mcp.ts to address this. (2 PRs)
members.cluster_pick_reason: PR #1617 preserves backward compatibility by detecting and forwarding plain JSON Schema objects as-is (via isLikelyJsonSchema) and widens the inputSchema type accordingly. PR #1596 takes the opposite approach — throwing a runtime error when nested objects are detected — which would be a breaking change for callers legitimately using the deprecated plain-JSON-Schema overload.

clusters.desc: Plain JSON Schema objects passed as inputSchema in the deprecated server.tool() overload are not handled correctly — both PRs modify the same code path in src/server/mcp.ts to address this. (2 PRs)

clusters.pick_reason: PR #1648's title accurately describes the actual diff (correcting the package name to @modelcontextprotocol/sdk). PR #1649's title claims to fix a Hono namespace issue but its diff is byte-for-byte identical to #1648 with no Hono-related changes, indicating a mislabeled or accidentally duplicated submission.
